paragraphs: Rabbi Abba bar Kohen: Demai, chapter 2, end of halakhah 1. He had a brother named Magbila, as in Berakhot, chapter 3, halakhah 1, folio 21a.
Rabbi Bun bar Kohen: Maaser Sheni, chapter 4, halakhah 6.

notes.text: The William Davidson digital Ketubot 105b fully writes Rav Nachman bar Kohen, supporting Rav for the supplied abbreviated ר׳ in the third notice.

These are separate notices, not evidence that all three men had one father. The checked Berakhot 3:1 passage names [Gedilah] as Rabbi Abba bar Kohen’s brother, beside Hyman’s Magbila. The intended Demai notice was not established in the bounded checks. Maaser Sheni 4:6 names Rabbi Bun bar Kohen, and Ketubot 105b names Rav Nachman bar Kohen. Hyman’s names and locators are retained.
